recommendation_priority: 1. Mini Test lesson below 80% -> recommend that exact lesson, weakest first.
2. If no weak lesson and Reading average is >5 points below Listening -> open Reading Quick Test.
3. If no weak lesson and Listening average is >5 points below Reading -> recommend Listening via mock-test center.
4. If history exists but skills are balanced -> recommend first unfinished lesson.
5. If insufficient personal data -> preserve original date-based daily lesson.
